coverage.scope: Six configured deterministic business modules, not application-wide coverage

limits: Authentication and cache APIs are mocked in unit integration tests; SQL and the page loader are real SQLite.
Four static markup tests do not exercise client navigation or click handlers. Prepared browser scenarios were not executed locally.
A transaction provides a consistent single read, not an immutable snapshot across later page navigations.
PostgreSQL, Linux, hosted migration shape and authenticated preview workflows remain unqualified for this candidate.
No dependency installation, application server, local browser, provider business call or hosted database write.
